I need to consider the evidence about which former prime minister appeared on the Morecambe and Wise Christmas Special in 1978.

The majority of agents (3 out of 4) indicate Harold Wilson with relatively high confidence (0.75-0.83). Agent 1 claims "unknown" with very high confidence (0.95), which seems contradictory - if they were truly uncertain, the confidence should be low, not high.

Let me consider the historical facts: The Morecambe and Wise Christmas specials were famous for featuring celebrity guests. Harold Wilson was Prime Minister from 1964-1970 and 1974-1976, so by 1978 he was indeed a former prime minister. He was known for making occasional television appearances.
